reasons.reader_question: The question is sharp: take the queen's knives or not, with Devan's fort priced against the answer. The Chathu ink doubt adds a quieter second hook.
reasons.change: Power reverses. The stolen leaf proves worthless, the queen holds every witness, and Neela leaves holding pages, a deadline and a lever on Devan.
reasons.romance_movement: This is indirect but new. Kettamala is priced against her answer, she sees her bond as her only freedom, and she gives up his noon hour to keep him safe.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Devan is offstage. Chemistry rests on the thumb-signal and the chin-cut memory, which work but are thin across a whole chapter.
reasons.character_logic: Neela smartly withholds the Chathu question and Nellimala. But she pockets a leash on Usha and the forty with no reaction.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Every choice costs something: the hour he waits, his fort, thirty paired wounds, and deciding his life without him. The deadline is the pass.
reasons.prose: The prose is clean, concrete and quotable ('precious knives'). The folded-question device recurs, and the witness rule is explained in narration as well as dialogue.
reasons.continuity: Consistent with F863-F870, F1028-F1035, F792, F864 and F1020. Sanu is twenty-six (sold at seven, nineteen years back). Usha is Nineteen.

fixes: At "Keep them," she said. "A witness who tells you": Neela now holds a fresh leash on Usha and forty more pages, the thing she swore never to be. She does not react, which is the static heroine failure. Add a beat as she picks them up. Her hand stops on Usha's page and she knows she is now Usha's master. She decides to hand it back by daylight or name the cost aloud. That choice feeds the cracked belief.

At "Only the two he had chosen to stay heard it, with Thilak at the door": this breaks Neela's promise from chapter 15 that the room holds only people the guard chose, since Thilak becomes an unchosen witness to every shape. Fix it one of two ways. Either have Neela ask each guard whether Thilak may stay, with Usha's "no one but Thilak" as one answer. Or post Thilak outside the net door with his back to it during each reading.

At "Neela folded the question small and put it away" and "She set it beside the Chathu question": the filing device repeats, echoing Usha folding her page small. Separately, "Burn a page and the witness remained. A page was only the memory" explains the rule the queen then states. This is repetition plus told exposition. Cut the narrated rule paragraph so the queen's line carries it. Keep one filing image and turn the second into a physical act, such as a thumbnail on the bangle.
reader_question: Will Neela take command of the queen's page-free night-guard by the pass, and what will it cost Devan's Kettamala if she refuses?
new_facts_assessment: new-facts.json is empty, but most of the draft's facts already sit in continuity (F863-F870, F1028-F1035). There are a few unlisted minor additions. The queen says she meant to scour the cliff of footholds for thirty years; F1029 says the spray slot, which is compatible. Thilak hears the shapes at the door. The queen leaves Usha's fresh page with Neela. Neela pricks with her right hand. All are consistent. Log Thilak as a new witness to all twenty-two shapes.
